text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- One of the chief suspects in the so-called NHE single quarters scam, housing ministry director Karl Gowaseb, could be rearrested because the house he put up as security for his N$100,000 bail is to be auctioned this week. The government is believed to have been defrauded of several million Namibian dollars involving renovations at the Katutura Single Quarters.
- The Windhoek city council has called on residents in the capital not to become complacent over the water situation, despite goods rains.

- German Defence Minister Volker Ruhe, on a brief visit to Windhoek, held talks with his Nambian counterpart Philemon Malima, Prime Minister Hage Geingob and President Sam Nujoma. Ruhe praised Namibia's policy of reconciliation saying it had been extended to the armed forces as well.
